description: Get public information including image_url and hub_graphic_url for one active Punto Biker or Smart Station by code, e.g. PB-00002 or SS-00002. When present, verified_data contains published BikerLink services, prices, offers and the verification date. ONLY human_verified:true with verification_label VERIFICATO DA AGENTE UMANO — BIKERLINK REAL indicates an authorized human agent attestation; consult verification_method for on_site versus live_video. Never infer on-site presence from live video.
